data.title: 花火 · 欢愉假面后的红金捉弄
data.action: 反坐在红色雕花栏杆上，手里把玩着狐狸假面在指间飞转，赤足在半空晃荡，粉黑渐变双马尾如蝶翼飞舞，狡黠绯瞳闪烁着颠倒乾坤的恶作剧狂欢。
data.location: 匹诺康尼黄金时刻的梦境戏院包厢露台，天空落着永恒的金色礼花与香槟喷泉
data.timeOfDay: 无尽梦境狂欢的最高潮
data.lighting: 露台外梦境世界的金粉霓虹与全息烟火投下炫目的流光溢彩，光怪陆离

data.description: 匹诺康尼黄金时刻的梦境戏院包厢露台，天空落着永恒的金色礼花与香槟喷泉。反坐在红色雕花栏杆上，手里把玩着狐狸假面在指间飞转，赤足在半空晃荡，粉黑渐变双马尾如蝶翼飞舞，狡黠绯瞳闪烁着颠倒乾坤的恶作剧狂欢。 她微微抬眸轻语——“猜猜看~今晚站在你面前的，是真正的小花火，还是某只小灰毛的梦境幻觉？答错的话……可是要被我玩坏的哦~”
data.promptProse: Perched backward atop the carved red balcony rail of a grand Penacony dream-theater box while golden confetti drifts around a bubbling champagne fountain, Sparkle wears a scarlet-red and lacquer-gold cutout tube dress with gold-laced sides and an asymmetrical sheer hem. Spinning her kitsune mask deftly on one finger while dangling her bare feet above the drop, she flashes a wicked, playful grin toward the viewer. Dazzling neon carnival lights and holographic fireworks wash the theater balcony in shifting color.
data.animaCaption: Perched barefoot on the red theater box railing in a gold-laced scarlet cutout tube dress, Sparkle spins a fox mask on her finger with a mischievous grin amidst falling golden confetti. Dazzling neon dreamscape lights illuminate the festive balcony.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a scarlet-red and lacquer-gold geometric cutout tube sleep dress laced at the sides with gold cords and falling into an asymmetrical sheer high-slit hem.
